notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W7-Q01_6 railway level crossing short-stacking warning sign 'KEEP ROUNDABOUT CLEAR' (crossing on the right-hand leg of a roundabout; 2023, page 6 of 7), fully dimensioned and drawn to scale, 1200 x 1400, R100. Upper part: yellow ground, yellow edge 10 + black border 10 (the sheet's 10 / 20); lower part from 1070 down: red with a white band 10 wide 10 in from the edge along the sides and bottom (the sheet's vectors), white legend 90 Series D. Right chain 95 / 900 / 75 / 45 / 90D / 45 / 90D / 60 = 1400: legend cap top(s) [1115, 1250]; word gaps [52] measured. Layout symbol (road, track, stacking arrows): the sheet PDF's own vector artwork (tools/symbols/qld_w7-q01-6_layout.svg), placed as drawn: 1069.9 x 899.9 at x 65.1, y 95.1 (the sheet's chain dimensions describe this artwork). Distance: numeral 100 Series D in the dashed box (170 wide at x 637) and 'm' Series E modified lower case 32 after it ('65Em' is the height of the lower-case m itself, drawn 64.8: cap height 86.67), baseline 241, as drawn ('insert appropriate distance in metres e.g. 40'): 40 and 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 generated (the owner: the variants that make sense, not every value). Black, red and white on retroreflective yellow.
